# Atoolix

> Free, browser-based online tools for everyday tasks: EMI and investment
> calculators, image compression and format conversion, PDF utilities,
> timezone and meeting-time tools, QR code generation, and file privacy
> checks. Files are processed client-side where possible; no signup
> required for any tool.

## Calculators

- [EMI Calculator](https://atoolix.com/tools/calculator/emi-calculator): Hub for home, car, and personal loan EMI calculators with amortization and prepayment comparisons.
- [Home Loan EMI Calculator](https://atoolix.com/tools/calculator/home-loan-emi-calculator): Home loan EMI, total interest, amortization, prepayment scenarios, and Indian tax-benefit context (Section 80C/24(b)).
- [FD Calculator](https://atoolix.com/tools/calculator/fd-calculator): Fixed deposit maturity value and interest calculator.
- [SIP Calculator](https://atoolix.com/tools/calculator/sip-calculator): Systematic investment plan returns calculator.
- [CAGR Calculator](https://atoolix.com/tools/calculator/cagr-calculator): Compound annual growth rate calculator for investments.
- [Retirement Calculator](https://atoolix.com/tools/calculator/retirement-calculator): Retirement corpus and savings planning calculator.

## Image tools

- [Image Compressor](https://atoolix.com/tools/image/compress-image): Compress JPG, PNG, and WEBP images with adjustable quality, entirely in-browser.
- [Compress Image to 100KB](https://atoolix.com/tools/image/compress-image-to-100kb): Compress an image to a specific target file size (100KB).
- [Background Remover](https://atoolix.com/tools/image/background-remover): Remove image backgrounds automatically in the browser.
- [Passport Photo Resizer](https://atoolix.com/tools/image/passport-photo-resizer): Resize and crop photos to standard passport/ID photo dimensions.
- [PNG to WEBP](https://atoolix.com/tools/image/png-to-webp): Convert PNG images to WEBP format.

## PDF tools

- [Merge PDF](https://atoolix.com/tools/pdf/merge-pdf): Combine multiple PDF files into one.
- [Split PDF](https://atoolix.com/tools/pdf/split-pdf): Split a PDF into separate files by page range.
- [Compress PDF](https://atoolix.com/tools/pdf/compress-pdf): Reduce PDF file size while preserving readability.

## Date & time tools

- [Timezone Converter](https://atoolix.com/tools/datetime/timezone-converter): Convert and compare times across time zones by city or country.
- [Meeting Time Finder](https://atoolix.com/tools/datetime/meeting-time-finder): Find overlapping meeting times across multiple time zones.

## Other utilities

- [QR Code Generator](https://atoolix.com/tools/qrcode/qr-code-generator): Generate QR codes for text, URLs, and contact info.
- [File Analyzer](https://atoolix.com/tools/privacysecurity/file-analyzer): Check files for hidden metadata, GPS data, and privacy/security issues.
